no_cost.50-observability.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: ttalkkak
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: ttalkkak-prometheus
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - ''
  resources:
  - pods
  verbs:
  - get
  - list
  - watch
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: ttalkkak-prometheus
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: prometheus
  namespace: ttalkkak
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: ttalkkak-prometheus
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: ttalkkak
data:
  prometheus.yml: "global:
  scrape_interval: 10s
rule_files:
- /etc/prometheus/alerts.yaml
\
    scrape_configs:
- job_name: pods
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
 \
    \ relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: 'true'
    source_labels:
\
    \    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape
  - regex: ([^:]+)(?::\\
    d+)?;(\d+)
    replacement: $1:$2
    source_labels:
    - __address__
 \
    \   - __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port
    target_label: __address__
\
    \  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name
\
    \    target_label: app
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_name
\
    \    target_label: pod
"
  alerts.yaml: "groups:
- name: ttalkkak
  rules:
  - alert: TtftSloBreach
  \
    \  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])))
\
    \      > 1.0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
\
    \      summary: TTFT p99가 SLO를 넘었습니다
  - alert: ItlSloBreach
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.99,\
    \ sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))
      > 0.1
\
    \    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary:\
    \ ITL p99가 SLO를 넘었습니다
  - alert: KvCacheHigh
    expr: max(vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc)\
    \ > 0.9
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
\
    \      summary: KV 캐시 90% 초과
  - alert: TenantQuota80
    expr: sum by (tenant)\
    \ (rate(ttalkkak_tokens_total{kind="total"}[1m])) * 60 > 0.8
      * max by\
    \ (tenant) (ttalkkak_tenant_limit_tokens_per_minute)
    for: 5m
    labels:
\
    \      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: 테넌트가 분당 토큰 한도의 80%를\
    \ 넘었습니다
  - alert: GpuHot
    expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP) > 85
    for:\
    \ 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: GPU\
    \ 온도 85°C 초과
  - alert: EngineDown
    expr: absent(vllm:num_requests_running)
\
    \    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary:\
    \ vLLM 지표가 들어오지 않습니다
"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: ttalkkak
  labels: &id001
    app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: *id001
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *id001
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prometheus
        image: prom/prometheus:v3.16.0
        args:
        - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=2d
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9090
        env: []
        volumeMounts:
        - name: cfg
          mountPath: /etc/prometheus
      volumes:
      - name: cfg
        configMap:
          name: prometheus
      serviceAccountName: prometheus
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: ttalkkak
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
  ports:
  - port: 9090
---
apiVersion: v1

  name: grafana-datasources
  namespace: ttalkkak
data:
  ds.yaml: "apiVersion: 1
datasources:
- isDefault: true
  name: Prometheus
 \
    \ type: prometheus
  uid: prometheus
  url: http://prometheus:9090
- name:\

  uid: jaeger
  url: http://jaeger:16686
"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: ttalkkak
  labels: &id001
    app.kubernetes.io/name: grafana
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: *id001
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *id001
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: grafana
        image: grafana/grafana:13.2.6
        args: []
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        env:
        - name: GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED
          value: 'false'
        - name: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: grafana-admin
              key: password
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ds
          mountPath: /etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
        - name: providers
          mountPath: /etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
        - name: dashboards
          mountPath: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
      volumes:
      - name: ds
        configMap:
          name: grafana-datasources
      - name: providers
        configMap:
          name: grafana-providers
      - name: dashboards
        configMap:
          name: grafana-dashboards
---

kind: Service
metadata:

spec:
  selector:

---
apiVersion: v1

    endpoint: jaeger:4317

    \ true
processors:
  batch: {}
receivers:

\
    \        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
service:

\
    \      - otlp
      processors:

---

        env: []

      summary: TTFT p99가 SLO를 넘었습니다
  - alert: ItlSloBreach
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))
      > 0.1
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: ITL p99가 SLO를 넘었습니다
  - alert: KvCacheHigh
    expr: max(vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc) > 0.9
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: KV 캐시 90% 초과
  - alert: TenantQuota80
    expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(ttalkkak_tokens_total{kind="total"}[1m])) * 60 > 0.8
      * max by (tenant) (ttalkkak_tenant_limit_tokens_per_minute)
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: 테넌트가 분당 토큰 한도의 80%를 넘었습니다
  - alert: GpuHot
    expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP) > 85
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: GPU 온도 85°C 초과
  - alert: EngineDown
    expr: absent(vllm:num_requests_running)
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: vLLM 지표가 들어오지 않습니다
